survivors.claim: The --all 🤷 branch line falls back to the literal reason 'no File Plan rows' whenever an entry reaches the 🤷 branch without a parallelUnknown set (an entry the annotation loop skipped via `continue` — a /spec:fix runner-up, or any entry whose parallel stayed undefined for a reason other than relateBriefs 'unknown'); the fallback can print a File Plan claim the derivation never made.
survivors.impact: A dashboard line may state a reason that was never derived for that entry, so the maintainer reads a File Plan explanation where none was computed.
survivors.evidence: Hunk: `: \`🤷 no brief — parallelism unknown (${e.parallelUnknown || 'no File Plan rows'})\``. parallelUnknown is only assigned at spec-status.js:584-585 inside `if (reason === undefined)` after `pairSerialReason`; the loop at :581 `continue`s before that for `/spec:fix`, blocked and queue entries, leaving parallelUnknown unset. Not executed as a repro against a fix entry — advisory (defensive fallback masking shape, per § Checks on every repo).

survivors.claim: Two new asserts in tests/spec-status.test.js carry only the raw stderr as their message with no consequence-of-failure sentence: `assert.strictEqual(rAll.status, 0, rAll.stderr)` (AC-10-3 test) and `assert.strictEqual(r.status, 0, r.stderr)` (AC-10-5 test).
survivors.impact: When either assertion fails the runner shows an exit code mismatch and raw stderr but not what breaks for the user, slowing diagnosis.
survivors.evidence: Diff lines added in range: `+  assert.strictEqual(rAll.status, 0, rAll.stderr)` and `+  assert.strictEqual(r.status, 0, r.stderr)`; pipeline rules § Review Checks: 'A new test whose asserts lack consequence-of-failure messages is soft'.
